This price is for 1 sachet :)
The unique taste of teh Tarik that can indulge the tongue, this typical Malay tea is made from a mixture of tea and milk. It is called teh Tarik because it is actually drawn, poured back and forth from the two pitchers so that it can cause fresh froth on the glass and create an extraordinary taste. Teh Tarik is widely available in packaged form, one of which is the Tarik product from MaxTea.
Can be served hot or with ice.
